# lumen

lumen is a tiny logging library for Node with levels, colors, JSON output, and file transports. It is
fast and has no dependencies.

## Installation

Install it with npm install lumen and require it in your code.

## Usage

To use it you write const log = require('lumen'); log.info('hi'). It supports different levels and
colors and json output.

## Contributing

For contributing see [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/acme/lumen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and there
is more on the wiki.
